latestVersion.changelog:
Competitor Spy Tool v1.0.0

- Initial release offering automated monitoring of competitor websites for price changes, new content, and keyword ranking shifts.
- Integrates with SerpAPI, Slack, Google Sheets, and supports real-time alerts and historical data logging.
- Features include: pricing monitoring, content tracking (blogs, RSS, announcements), keyword position tracking, landing page monitoring (with screenshots), and competitive intelligence reporting.
- Highly configurable via environment variables and easy setup for multi-domain tracking and Slack notifications.
- Includes sample prompts, setup instructions, and example output formats for actionable competitive insights.
